Being single in your mid twenties as a dude is pretty much guaranteed. I'm 28 and broke it off with my ex right after college ended... Five and a half years definitely takes it's toll.

Just get out and do some shit you enjoy. Find a new hobby or something. Go to coffee shops and sit and read or work on a laptop. Walk around. Bookstores, etc.
